original_title: Destiny 2 players share their memories and reviews - positive and negative - as Bungie calls time
summary_en: Bungie fans are battling it out on Destiny 2 's Steam page, where unhappy fans are mounting a negative review campaign, and supporters are doing their best to mitigate it. Read more
